name: An Untitled Form Of Derangement
source:
You play as Ezze. A man with deep rooted problems following him in his life, leading to addiction, anger, and isolation. 

These difficulties usually help you put up a barrier, preventing you from meeting people. But this doesn’t seem to work on a very persistent stranger in the library you laze at. Despite all efforts made to resist, you make a new friend.

[From [url=https://muetere.itch.io/an-untitled-form-of-derangement]Itch.io[/url]]
